as_told.title: Raytheon triangle and holographic craft at Fort Irwin

plain: A man named Steven DNA is said to have seen a man-made triangular craft built by the defense company Raytheon at Fort Irwin, an Army base in California, and he and his wife were later abducted by it. Steven Greer relays the account on two visits to the show, showing it in his book Disclosure: An Illustrated History, and the second time he adds that the craft could make holograms and "could be used in a hoaxed invasion," meaning a fake alien attack. If true, it would mean some craft taken for alien ones are human-built.
